title: Southfork Ranch and Ewing Mansion Tour from Dallas
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the legendary Southfork Ranch, a must-visit for fans of the iconic TV series Dallas. This 4-hour shared tour offers an immersive experience, showcasing the stunning ranch grounds and the famous Ewing Mansion. Dive into television history with your expert guide, who shares behind-the-scenes stories and fascinating filming secrets. Discover exclusive memorabilia at the “Dallas Legends” museum exhibit, including the notorious gun that shot J.R. Perfect for both devoted fans and casual travelers, the tour includes convenient hotel pickup from downtown Dallas within a 3-mile radius.
